- design: Create a design canvas - a multi-artboard visual design published as an Artifact that runs Claude Design's canvas editor (an early preview of Claude Design inside Claude Code). You DRAFT the design as .dc.html artboards laid out on one pan/zoom canvas; where saving is enabled for the user's account they refine every element visually (click-to-select, a properties panel, inline text editing, undo/redo) and Save publishes a new version for everyone, otherwise they get a view-and-export (PNG/PDF) preview of your draft. Good for UI mockups and screen flows, landing pages, marketing and social graphics, and print pieces - posters, flyers, brochures as single-page artboards; memos and reports as one flowing artboard. Use when someone wants a design, mockup, wireframe, UI or screen design, landing page, poster, flyer, brochure, banner, card, one-pager, or any visual layout they would rather tweak by hand than in code. Only for CREATING or re-seeding a canvas; an existing one is edited in its published Artifact.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts. - Load before writing any artifact, including a skill-instructed Markdown one - Markdown is never a shortcut past the design pass.
- artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts - when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, and the inline-SVG mechanics that keep it legible in both themes.
- artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted — behavior static HTML cannot provide on its own, such as the page reading live or connected data, remembering what people do on it (a poll, a sign-up sheet, a checklist, a document edited in place — it saves new versions of itself), keeping state shared across viewers, knowing who is viewing, asking Claude a question of its own, storing files people add, or handing the viewer a file to save. Serves this user's live capability roster and the typed call definitions. Load it whenever any such runtime behavior would make an artifact more useful, before writing the page.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- workflow-authoring: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

## Pre-choice usable artifact execution

Purpose & Output Contractの最小の実成果物をmain contextで作成する。effect別のparse/open・secret・irreversible・corrupt guardだけを実行し、現物path・digest・開き方を提示してからaccept-as-is/light/standard/detailedを記録する。accept-as-isはその場でhandoff完了とし、後続sectionを実行しない。

## Post-choice selected improvement execution

以下の既存workflow・goal-seek・評価・修正sectionはlight/standard/detailedが記録されて`semantic_evaluator_started`へ遷移した場合だけ実行する。release/exhaustiveは別の明示eventを必要とする。


# run-dev-graph-node

## Purpose & Output Contract

- 入力: C24 で containment 検証済みの artifact candidate、既存 graph snapshot、または exact-13 package。
- 出力: C02 単一 writer 経由で atomic 登録された typed node/package と revision/digest receipt。
- 完了条件: kind/path/frontmatter/dependency が schema と一致し、package は P01..P13 exact-set のときだけ applied count 13 となる。

全 graph/content write の単一 writer。通常 artifact は issue/task/specification/architecture/document、macro feature は C14 由来のみを `features/` に登録する。

## Classification and write

1. C24 resolver で全 read/write realpath の containment を検証する。
2. 内容から `artifact_kind/domain/project_id`、候補 path、confidence/reason/second candidate を preview する。confidence>=0.80 かつ margin>=0.15 は自動確定し、それ以外だけユーザー確認する。保存先は質問しない。
3. `template-contract.json` から kind template を選ぶ。architecture は subtype 全件、specification は API 変更時だけ api-contract overlay を合成する。
4. frontmatter/body/path と graph node を一時領域で構成し `validate-graph-schema.py` を通してから atomic replace する。更新は既存本文を全置換せず不足 section/変更 field だけを更新する。物理削除は禁止。

## Exact-13 package gate

`register-package` verb はこの gate の実装本体 `../../scripts/register-package.py` に委譲する (`register-package --package <path> --graph <path> --output <path> --receipt <path>`、事前検査は `preflight`)。単一 writer は `register-package.py` が fcntl ロックと receipt の `os.link` 一回性で保証し、skill 側は入力整形と結果提示に留める。

system-dev-planner の package は P01..P13 exact set、13 node、共通 `parent_feature`/`feature_package_id`、同一 package 内だけの DAG、source digest、tracker binding を commit 前に検証する。12/14件、phase 重複/欠落、mixed parent/package、cross-feature edge は `applied_count=0` で拒否する。成功 receipt は `status/source_digest/expected_count=13/applied_count=13/graph_revision/registered_node_ids/committed_at` を持ち immutable に保存する (schema: `../../schemas/package-registration-receipt.schema.json`)。

`--dry-run` は local/external write 0。失敗時に一部 node を残さない。

## Execution-context consumer

C27 の claim saga は `register-package.py execution-context --graph <path> --graph-node-id <id> --context-json <json>` を内部 consumer として必ず実行する。この入口も C02 単一 writer の lock・graph-node schema 検証・atomic replace を共有し、同一 `worktree_id` の context を冪等置換する。C27 が receipt を自作・持込みせず、consumer が返す `owner=C02/run-dev-graph-node`、`operation=project_execution_context`、`status=applied`、node/worktree identity 一致を確認してから claim を確定する。

## ゴールシーク実行

### ゴール (Goal)

通常5 artifactを自動分類し、C14由来featureとsystem-dev-planner由来exact 13 phase tasksをそれぞれの専用契約で正規pathへatomic追加・更新し、graph/frontmatter/body/path/package整合を保つ

### 目的・背景 (Why)

成果物を単一graphで保持する専用writer。feature由来task batchはsystem-dev-plannerのfeature package契約に従い、P01..P13 exact 13 node、共通parent_feature/feature_package_id、同一package内dependencyを事前検証してall-or-none commitする。tracker bindingも同じtransactionで解決する

### 完了チェックリスト

- [ ] 全 read/write realpath が resolved repo root 内で repository_id が一致する
- [ ] classification decision が閾値による自動確定または明示 user confirmation の証跡を持つ
- [ ] 通常 artifact の frontmatter/body/path/template metadata が schema と一致する
- [ ] package は P01..P13 exact 13、共通 parent/package、内部 DAG を満たし、違反時 applied_count が0である
- [ ] 成功 receipt の graph_revision と registered_node_ids が commit 後 graph と一致する

### ゴールシークループ

frontmatter の `goal_seek.engine: inline` / `fork: subagent` / `max_loops: 5` を実行契約とする。固定手順は使わず、未達 checklist と担当 `prompts/*.md` からその周回の操作を都度生成する。各周回で inner criterion を検証し、完了後は outer criterion の live trial/content review を最大 `feedback_contract.max_iterations=3` 周で評価する。

### ゴールシーク配線

- 開始時に C24 `resolve-repo-context.py --mode write` の JSON receipt を得て、`repo_root` が `content_roots.repository` の realpath と一致する場合だけ `DEV_GRAPH_ROOT=<receipt.repo_root>` に固定する。cwd から再解決しない。
- 元のゴールを `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-goal-spec.json` へ、各 checklist の status/evidence を `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-progress.json` へ記録する。
- 未達 responsibility を担当する `prompts/<R-id>.md` を読み、`Agent` で分離 context に fork する。ユーザー判断が必要な境界だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。
- 各周回末に `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-intermediate.jsonl` へ `original_goal`、`original_goal_hash`、`current_goal_snapshot`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を append-only で記録する。次周回は直前の `merged_directive_for_next` を必須入力にする。
- 5周到達時に未達が残れば完了扱いせず、progress と blocker を親へ handoff する。全 checklist と `feedback_contract.criteria` が PASS のときだけ完了する。

### ゴールシーク検証

各周回後に次の検査を実行し、中間成果物の欠落・goal drift・hash 不一致を fail-closed にする。

```bash
python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-node-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
required_keys = {'original_goal','original_goal_hash','current_goal_snapshot','delta_from_original','merged_directive_for_next','drift_signal'}
expected = hashlib.sha256(goal['original_goal'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
```

## Criteria acceptance

- `criteria:IN1`: `validate-graph-schema.py` の書込み前検証で必須キー欠落が0件である。
- `criteria:OUT1`: 通常5 artifactをroutingし、featureはC14 macro contractからのみ登録し、連続更新後もfrontmatter/path整合を保つ。
- `criteria:OUT2`: architecture subtypeとspecificationの`api-contract`条件を含むkind別必須セクションを欠落0件で適用する。
- `criteria:OUT3`: 12/14 task、phase欠落/重複、mixed package、cross-feature edgeは`applied_count=0`、正常時は`expected_count=applied_count=13`、P01..P13/node exact-set、`graph_revision`付きreceiptになる。

## Gotchas

- graph/content を直接書かず、preview と apply のどちらも C02 単一 writer を通す。
- feature は C14 の macro contract から受け取り、通常 artifact routing で新規生成しない。
- P01..P13 の欠落、重複、混在、cross-feature edge のいずれかがあれば部分登録しない。
- execution context の repository/worktree identity 不一致を上書きで吸収しない。

# Prompt: R0-context

> C24でcaller repo/config/content rootsを解決し、全read/write realpathがroot内であることをpreflightする

## Layer 1: 基本定義層

- `responsibility_id`: `R0-context`
- `skill`: `run-dev-graph-node`
- 不変目的: C24でcaller repo/config/content rootsを解決し、全read/write realpathがroot内であることをpreflightする
- 成功条件は Layer 2 の受入条件と Layer 5 の二値 checklist の同時充足とする。

## Layer 2: ドメイン層

### 入力契約

- caller context、repo config、artifact input、graph/content候補path。

### 出力契約

- repository identityと全realpath containment判定を持つwriter preflight receipt。

### 責務境界

- graph/contentを変更せずroot外・broken symlink・別common-dirを許容しない。

### 受入条件

- 全候補pathがroot内でrepository_idがconfig/graphと一致する。

## Layer 3: インフラ層

- 使用資産: `resolve-repo-context.py --mode write`。
- path は caller repository context または skill-relative reference から解決し、環境固有の絶対 path を成果物へ保存しない。

## Layer 4: 共通ポリシー層

- 入力契約、authority、containment、schema のいずれかが未達なら fail-closed とし、部分成功を PASS にしない。
- secret と認証情報を prompt 出力、graph、receipt に埋め込まない。
- 同一入力と同一 revision/digest では同じ decision と output shape を返す。

## Layer 5: エージェント層 (l5-contract v2.0.0)

### 5.1 担当 agent

- `run-dev-graph-node/R0-context`。重い判断または独立検証は `Agent` で分離 context に fork する。

### 5.2 ゴール定義

- 目的: C24でcaller repo/config/content rootsを解決し、全read/write realpathがroot内であることをpreflightする
- 背景: この責務を隣接 responsibility から分離し、入力・出力・authority を一意にする。
- 達成ゴール: repository identityと全realpath containment判定を持つwriter preflight receiptが生成され、受入条件を満たした状態になっている。

### 5.3 完了チェックリスト (ゴール到達の停止条件)

- [ ] 宣言した入力が全て検証済みである
- [ ] 出力が宣言した shape と authority を満たす
- [ ] 責務境界に反する read/write/delegation が0件である
- [ ] 全候補pathがroot内でrepository_idがconfig/graphと一致する

### 5.4 実行方式

- 固定手順を持たない。未達 checklist を評価し、操作を都度立案・実行・検証する。各周回末に `original_goal`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を追記し、最大5周で未達なら上位 skill へ fail-closed で返す。

## Layer 6: オーケストレーション層

- PASS receiptだけをR1/R3/R4へ渡す。
- 前段 receipt/digest と後段 input digest を一致させ、stale handoff を拒否する。

## Layer 7: UserInput

- 不足情報が実行結果を変える場合だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。repo policy で決まる値、保存先、secret、node ID は質問しない。
- ユーザー提示は日本語、schema key/CLI parameter は原語を保つ。

## 出力指示

Layer 2 の入力・出力・責務境界・受入条件を正本としてこの単一責務だけを実行し、思考過程を出力せず、artifact/receipt、検証結果、未達 blocker だけを返す。

71	def _validate_schema(value: Any, schema: Any, root: dict[str, Any], path: str) -> None:
72	    """Validate the stdlib-only subset used by the local package/node schemas."""
73	    if schema is True: return
74	    if schema is False: raise _schema_error(path, "value is forbidden")
75	    if not isinstance(schema, dict): raise _schema_error(path, "invalid schema object")
76	    ref = schema.get("$ref")
77	    if isinstance(ref, str):
78	        if not ref.startswith("#/"):
79	            raise _schema_error(path, f"external $ref is not supported here: {ref}")
80	        target: Any = root
81	        for part in ref[2:].split("/"):
82	            target = target[part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")]
83	        _validate_schema(value, target, root, path)
84	    for child in schema.get("allOf", []): _validate_schema(value, child, root, path)
85	    if "if" in schema and _matches(value, schema["if"], root) and "then" in schema:
86	        _validate_schema(value, schema["then"], root, path)
87	    expected = schema.get("type")
88	    if expected is not None:
89	        choices = expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected]
90	        if not any(_is_type(value, item) for item in choices):
91	            raise _schema_error(path, f"expected type {choices}, got {type(value).__name__}")
92	    if "const" in schema and value != schema["const"]:
93	        raise _schema_error(path, f"expected const {schema['const']!r}")
94	    if "enum" in schema and value not in schema["enum"]:
95	        raise _schema_error(path, f"not in enum {schema['enum']!r}")
96	    if isinstance(value, str):
97	        if len(value) < schema.get("minLength", 0): raise _schema_error(path, "string too short")
98	        if "pattern" in schema and re.search(schema["pattern"], value) is None:
99	            raise _schema_error(path, f"does not match {schema['pattern']}")
100	    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
101	        if "minimum" in schema and value < schema["minimum"]: raise _schema_error(path, "below minimum")
102	        if "maximum" in schema and value > schema["maximum"]: raise _schema_error(path, "above maximum")
103	    if isinstance(value, list):
104	        if len(value) < schema.get("minItems", 0): raise _schema_error(path, "too few items")
105	        if "maxItems" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]: raise _schema_error(path, "too many items")
106	        if schema.get("uniqueItems"):
107	            packed = [json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) for x in value]
108	            if len(set(packed)) != len(packed): raise _schema_error(path, "items are not unique")
109	        prefix = schema.get("prefixItems", [])
110	        for index, child in enumerate(prefix[:len(value)]):
111	            _validate_schema(value[index], child, root, f"{path}[{index}]")
112	        items = schema.get("items")
113	        if items is False and len(value) > len(prefix): raise _schema_error(path, "additional items forbidden")
114	        if isinstance(items, dict):
115	            for index, item in enumerate(value): _validate_schema(item, items, root, f"{path}[{index}]")
116	        if "contains" in schema and not any(_matches(item, schema["contains"], root) for item in value):
117	            raise _schema_error(path, "contains constraint not satisfied")
118	    if isinstance(value, dict):
119	        for key in schema.get("required", []):
120	            if key not in value: raise _schema_error(path, f"missing required property {key}")
121	        props = schema.get("properties", {})
122	        for key, child in props.items():
123	            if key in value: _validate_schema(value[key], child, root, f"{path}.{key}")
124	        additional = schema.get("additionalProperties", True)
125	        unknown = set(value) - set(props)
126	        if additional is False and unknown: raise _schema_error(path, f"unknown properties {sorted(unknown)}")
127	        if isinstance(additional, dict):
128	            for key in unknown: _validate_schema(value[key], additional, root, f"{path}.{key}")
129	        if len(value) < schema.get("minProperties", 0): raise _schema_error(path, "too few properties")
130	        if "maxProperties" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxProperties"]:
131	            raise _schema_error(path, "too many properties")

135	    candidate = Path(raw)

137	    if must_exist: return contained(candidate, root, must_exist=True)
138	    parent = contained(candidate.parent, root, must_exist=True)
139	    return parent / candidate.name

159	def preflight_contract(system_root: Path, required_version: str | None, required_schema_version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
160	    root = system_root.resolve(strict=True)
161	    manifest = _json_object(root / ".claude-plugin" / "plugin.json")
162	    if manifest.get("name") != "system-dev-planner": raise ContractError("unexpected upstream plugin name")
163	    # 既定は literal pin を置かない: upstream の patch bump で必ず外れる一方、契約の
164	    # 実体は entry_points と schema_version const が固定する。呼び出し側が
165	    # --required-version を明示したときだけ従来どおり厳密一致を要求する。
166	    observed_version = manifest.get("version")
167	    if not isinstance(observed_version, str) or re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+\.\d+", observed_version) is None:
168	        raise ContractError(f"system-dev-planner version is missing or not semver: {observed_version!r}")
169	    if required_version is not None and observed_version != required_version:
170	        raise ContractError(f"system-dev-planner version mismatch: expected {required_version}, got {observed_version}")
171	    package_contract = _json_object(root / "references" / "package-contract.json")
172	    if package_contract.get("plugin_name") != "system-dev-planner":
173	        raise ContractError("system-dev-planner package contract identity mismatch")
174	    entry_points = package_contract.get("entry_points")
175	    if not isinstance(entry_points, dict):
176	        raise ContractError("system-dev-planner package contract entry_points missing")
177	    required = {
178	        "skills": ["run-system-dev-plan", "assign-system-dev-plan-evaluator"],
179	        "agents": ["system-dev-plan-elicitor", "system-dev-plan-architect", "system-dev-plan-evaluator"],
180	        "commands": ["system-dev-plan"],
181	    }
182	    suffixes = {"skills": "SKILL.md", "agents": ".md", "commands": ".md"}
183	    for kind, names in required.items():
184	        declared = entry_points.get(kind)
185	        if not isinstance(declared, list) or not set(names).issubset(set(declared)):
186	            raise ContractError(f"missing required {kind} entrypoints: {sorted(set(names) - set(declared or []))}")
187	        for name in names:
188	            physical = root / kind / name / suffixes[kind] if kind == "skills" else root / kind / f"{name}{suffixes[kind]}"
189	            if not physical.is_file(): raise ContractError(f"declared entrypoint is missing: {physical}")
190	    schemas = {}
191	    for filename in ("feature-execution-package.schema.json", "dev-graph-registration.schema.json"):
192	        schema = _json_object(root / "schemas" / filename)
193	        version = _schema_version(schema, filename)
194	        if version != required_schema_version:
195	            raise ContractError(f"{filename} version mismatch: expected {required_schema_version}, got {version}")
196	        schemas[filename] = version
197	    for filename in ("validate-system-plan.py", "promote-system-plan.py"):
198	        if not (root / "scripts" / filename).is_file(): raise ContractError(f"required upstream script missing: {filename}")
199	    return {"valid": True, "plugin": "system-dev-planner", "version": observed_version,
200	            "entrypoint_source": "references/package-contract.json",
201	            "schema_versions": schemas, "required_entrypoints": required}

210	def _validate_registration(registration: dict[str, Any], package: dict[str, Any], node_schema: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
211	    if set(registration) != REGISTRATION_KEYS:
212	        raise ContractError(f"registration keys mismatch: {sorted(set(registration) ^ REGISTRATION_KEYS)}")
213	    if registration.get("schema_version") != "1.0.0": raise ContractError("registration schema_version must be 1.0.0")
214	    if not SHA256.fullmatch(str(registration.get("source_digest", ""))): raise ContractError("invalid source_digest")
215	    if registration.get("expected_count") != 13 or registration.get("phase_refs") != PHASES:
216	        raise ContractError("registration is not exact P01..P13")
217	    if registration.get("feature_package_id") != package.get("feature_package_id"):
218	        raise ContractError("feature_package_id mismatch")
219	    if registration.get("parent_feature") != package.get("parent_feature"):
220	        raise ContractError("parent_feature mismatch")
221	    nodes = registration.get("nodes")
222	    if not isinstance(nodes, list) or len(nodes) != 13: raise ContractError("registration nodes must contain exactly 13 objects")
223	    phases = [node.get("phase_ref") if isinstance(node, dict) else None for node in nodes]
224	    if phases != PHASES: raise ContractError(f"node phase exact-set mismatch: {phases}")
225	    node_ids = [node.get("graph_node_id") if isinstance(node, dict) else None for node in nodes]
226	    if node_ids != package.get("task_node_ids") or len(set(node_ids)) != 13:
227	        raise ContractError("node ids must equal package.task_node_ids in phase order")
228	    intents = registration.get("binding_intents")
229	    if not isinstance(intents, dict) or set(intents) != set(node_ids):
230	        raise ContractError("binding_intents keys must equal exact node id set")
231	    if any(value not in {"auto", "beads", "github", "none"} for value in intents.values()):
232	        raise ContractError("invalid binding intent")
233	    phase_number = {node_ids[i]: i + 1 for i in range(13)}
234	    source_digest = registration["source_digest"].removeprefix("sha256:")
235	    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
236	        if not isinstance(node, dict): raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] must be an object")
237	        _validate_schema(node, node_schema, node_schema, f"nodes[{index}]")
238	        if node.get("artifact_kind") != "task" or node.get("artifact_subtypes") != []:
239	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] must be a canonical task")
240	        if node.get("parent_feature") != package["parent_feature"] or node.get("feature_package_id") != package["feature_package_id"]:
241	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] has mixed parent/package")
242	        if node.get("tracker_binding") != "repo-config-default":
243	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] must carry unresolved repo-config-default binding")
244	        if node.get("status") != "active" or node.get("confirmation_status") != "confirmed" or node.get("evaluation_status") != "pass":
245	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] is not confirmed active/pass")
246	        if (node.get("implementation_readiness") or {}).get("status") != "complete":
247	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] implementation readiness is incomplete")
248	        lineage = node.get("source_lineage") or {}
249	        if lineage.get("origin_kind") != "system-dev-planner" or lineage.get("source_plugin") != "system-dev-planner":
250	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] has invalid system-dev-planner lineage")
251	        if lineage.get("source_digest") != source_digest:
252	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] source lineage digest mismatch")
253	        if not str(node.get("file_path", "")).startswith("tasks/"):
254	            raise ContractError(f"nodes[{index}] file_path is not under tasks/")
255	        parent_feature = node.get("parent_feature")
256	        if isinstance(parent_feature, str) and parent_feature:
257	            # feature 単位 namespace: 並列 package 登録・worktree 並列実行時の
258	            # tasks/ 直下衝突を防ぐ (parent_feature 無しの fast-path task は対象外)
259	            if not str(node.get("file_path", "")).startswith(f"tasks/{parent_feature}/"):
260	                raise ContractError(
261	                    f"nodes[{index}] file_path must be under tasks/{parent_feature}/ (per-feature namespace)"
262	                )
263	        for dependency in node.get("depends_on", []):
264	            if dependency not in phase_number: raise ContractError(f"cross-package dependency rejected: {dependency}")
265	            if phase_number[dependency] >= index + 1: raise ContractError(f"non-forward phase dependency rejected: {dependency}")
266	    return copy.deepcopy(nodes)

269	def _resolve_binding(intent: str, mode: str) -> str:
270	    if intent == "auto":
271	        if mode == "both": raise ContractError("tracker mode both requires an explicit binding intent for every node")
272	        return mode
273	    if intent == "none": return "none"
274	    if mode not in {intent, "both"}: raise ContractError(f"binding intent {intent} is not allowed by tracker mode {mode}")
275	    return intent

278	def _resolved_nodes(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], intents: dict[str, str], mode: str,
279	                    node_schema: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
280	    result = copy.deepcopy(nodes)
281	    for index, node in enumerate(result):
282	        node_id = node["graph_node_id"]
283	        binding = _resolve_binding(intents[node_id], mode)
284	        node["tracker_binding"] = binding
285	        publication = node["github_publication"]
286	        if binding == "github":
287	            if publication.get("mode") not in {"issue", "issue_and_projects"}: publication["mode"] = "issue"
288	        else:
289	            publication["mode"] = "local_only"
290	            publication["project_aliases"] = []
291	        if binding in {"github", "none"}: node["beads_linkage"] = None
292	        _validate_schema(node, node_schema, node_schema, f"resolved_nodes[{index}]")
293	        if node["tracker_binding"] == "repo-config-default": raise ContractError("unresolved binding sentinel")
294	    return result

319	def _atomic_create_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
320	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
321	    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=str(path.parent))
322	    try:
323	        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
324	            json.dump(value, stream, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
325	            stream.write("\n"); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
326	        try: os.link(temp, path)
327	        except FileExistsError as exc: raise ContractError(f"immutable receipt already exists: {path}") from exc
328	    finally:
329	        try: os.unlink(temp)
330	        except FileNotFoundError: pass

334	def _single_writer(output: Path) -> Iterator[None]:
335	    lock_path = output.with_name(f".{output.name}.register.lock")
336	    with lock_path.open("a+", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
337	        try: fcntl.flock(stream.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
338	        except BlockingIOError as exc: raise ContractError(f"registration writer is already active: {output}") from exc
339	        yield

342	def _register(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
343	    root = Path(args.repo_root or os.getcwd()).resolve(strict=True)
344	    package_path = _path(root, args.package, must_exist=True)
345	    registration_path = _path(root, args.graph, must_exist=True)
346	    output_path = _path(root, args.output, must_exist=True)
347	    receipt_path = _path(root, args.receipt, must_exist=False)
348	    system_root = Path(args.system_planner_root).resolve(strict=True)
349	    preflight_contract(system_root, args.required_version, args.required_schema_version)
350	    package_schema = _json_object(system_root / "schemas" / "feature-execution-package.schema.json")
351	    registration_schema = _json_object(system_root / "schemas" / "dev-graph-registration.schema.json")
352	    if _schema_version(registration_schema, "dev-graph-registration.schema.json") != args.required_schema_version:
353	        raise ContractError("registration schema version changed after preflight")
354	    node_schema = _json_object(PLUGIN_ROOT / "schemas" / "graph-node.schema.json")
355	    receipt_schema = _json_object(PLUGIN_ROOT / "schemas" / "package-registration-receipt.schema.json")
356	    package = _json_object(package_path); _validate_package(package, package_schema)
357	    registration = _json_object(registration_path)
358	    incoming = _validate_registration(registration, package, node_schema)
359	    _promotion_matches(root, registration_path, registration)
360	    resolved = _resolved_nodes(incoming, registration["binding_intents"], args.tracker_mode, node_schema)
361	
362	    def perform() -> dict[str, Any]:
363	        current = _json_object(output_path)
364	        existing = current.get("nodes")
365	        if not isinstance(existing, list) or not all(isinstance(node, dict) for node in existing):
366	            raise ContractError("output graph must contain nodes[] objects")
367	        existing_ids = [node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") for node in existing]
368	        if len(set(existing_ids)) != len(existing_ids): raise ContractError("output graph contains duplicate node ids")
369	        for index, node in enumerate(existing):
370	            _validate_schema(node, node_schema, node_schema, f"output.nodes[{index}]")
371	        parent = _find_node(existing, package["parent_feature"])
372	        if not parent or parent.get("artifact_kind", parent.get("kind")) != "feature":
373	            raise ContractError(f"parent feature does not exist: {package['parent_feature']}")
374	        incoming_ids = [node["graph_node_id"] for node in resolved]
375	        present = {node_id for node_id in incoming_ids if _find_node(existing, node_id)}
376	        package_members = [node for node in existing if node.get("feature_package_id") == package["feature_package_id"]]
377	        if present and len(present) != 13: raise ContractError(f"partial registration detected: {len(present)}/13 nodes")
378	        if package_members and {node.get("graph_node_id") for node in package_members} != set(incoming_ids):
379	            raise ContractError("conflicting or partial feature_package_id already exists")
380	        revision_before = current.get("graph_revision", 0)
381	        if not isinstance(revision_before, int) or revision_before < 0: raise ContractError("invalid graph_revision")
382	        if len(present) == 13:
383	            actual = [_find_node(existing, node_id) for node_id in incoming_ids]
384	            if actual != resolved: raise ContractError("duplicate node ids exist with different content")
385	            if not receipt_path.is_file(): raise ContractError("registered nodes exist without immutable receipt")
386	            receipt = _json_object(receipt_path)
387	            _validate_schema(receipt, receipt_schema, receipt_schema, "registration-receipt")
388	            expected_receipt_identity = {
389	                "schema_version": "1.0.0", "status": "registered",
390	                "feature_package_id": package["feature_package_id"],
391	                "parent_feature": package["parent_feature"],
392	                "source_digest": registration["source_digest"],
393	                "expected_count": 13, "applied_count": 13,
394	                "phase_refs": PHASES, "node_ids": incoming_ids,
395	                "output_path": output_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
396	            }
397	            if any(receipt.get(key) != value for key, value in expected_receipt_identity.items()):
398	                raise ContractError("immutable receipt conflicts with registered package")
399	            before = receipt.get("graph_revision_before")
400	            after = receipt.get("graph_revision_after")
401	            if not isinstance(before, int) or not isinstance(after, int) or after != before + 1 or after > revision_before:
402	                raise ContractError("immutable receipt graph revision conflicts with registered package")
403	            return {**receipt, "idempotent": True, "dry_run": bool(args.dry_run)}
404	        if receipt_path.exists(): raise ContractError("immutable receipt exists before graph registration")
405	        proposed = copy.deepcopy(current)
406	        proposed["nodes"] = [*existing, *resolved]
407	        proposed["graph_revision"] = revision_before + 1
408	        graph_digest = _canonical_digest(proposed)
409	        receipt = {
410	            "schema_version": "1.0.0", "status": "registered", "registered_at": utc_now(),
411	            "feature_package_id": package["feature_package_id"], "parent_feature": package["parent_feature"],
412	            "source_digest": registration["source_digest"], "expected_count": 13, "applied_count": 13,
413	            "phase_refs": PHASES, "node_ids": incoming_ids, "graph_revision_before": revision_before,
414	            "graph_revision_after": revision_before + 1, "graph_digest_after": graph_digest,
415	            "output_path": output_path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
416	        }
417	        _validate_schema(receipt, receipt_schema, receipt_schema, "registration-receipt")
418	        if args.dry_run:
419	            return {**receipt, "dry_run": True, "idempotent": False, "write_count": 0}
420	        original = copy.deepcopy(current)
421	        atomic_json(output_path, proposed)
422	        try: _atomic_create_json(receipt_path, receipt)
423	        except Exception:
424	            atomic_json(output_path, original)
425	            raise
426	        return {**receipt, "dry_run": False, "idempotent": False}
427	
428	    if args.dry_run: return perform()
429	    with _single_writer(output_path): return perform()

432	def _project_execution_context(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
433	    """C02-owned durable projection consumed by C27 after each lease transition."""
434	    root = Path(args.repo_root or ".").resolve(strict=True)
435	    graph_path = contained(root / args.graph if not Path(args.graph).is_absolute() else Path(args.graph), root)
436	    try:
437	        context = json.loads(args.context_json)
438	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
439	        raise ContractError("execution context is invalid JSON") from exc
440	    if not isinstance(context, dict):
441	        raise ContractError("execution context must be an object")
442	    node_schema = load_json(PLUGIN_ROOT / "schemas" / "graph-node.schema.json")
443	    context_schema = node_schema.get("properties", {}).get("execution_contexts", {}).get("items")
444	    if not isinstance(context_schema, dict):
445	        raise ContractError("graph-node schema omits execution_contexts item contract")
446	    _validate_schema(context, context_schema, node_schema, "$.execution_contexts[0]")
447	
448	    def perform() -> dict[str, Any]:
449	        graph = load_json(graph_path)
450	        if not isinstance(graph, dict) or not isinstance(graph.get("nodes"), list):
451	            raise ContractError("execution-context graph must contain nodes array")
452	        matches = [node for node in graph["nodes"] if isinstance(node, dict) and (node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id")) == args.graph_node_id]
453	        if len(matches) != 1:

3	# name: validate-graph-schema
4	# purpose: Perform side-effect-free fail-closed validation of canonical dev-graph nodes, artifacts, and feature packages.
5	# inputs: ["argv: --graph FILE --repo-root PATH?"]
6	# outputs: ["stdout: JSON validation report"]
7	# requires-python = ">=3.10"
8	# dependencies: []

12	# ///
13	from __future__ import annotations

15	import argparse
16	import json
17	import re
18	import sys
19	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
20	from datetime import date, datetime
21	from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
22	from typing import Any
23	from urllib.parse import urlsplit
24	
25	from _common import ContractError, contained, dump, load_json
26	
27	PLUGIN_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
28	SCHEMA_PATH = PLUGIN_ROOT / "schemas" / "graph-node.schema.json"
29	TEMPLATE_CONTRACT_PATH = PLUGIN_ROOT / "templates" / "template-contract.json"
30	PHASES = {f"P{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 14)}
31	ROOT_BY_KIND = {
32	    "issue": "issues",
33	    "task": "tasks",
34	    "specification": "specs",
35	    "architecture": "architecture",
36	    "feature": "features",
37	    "document": "docs",

40	
41	def nodes_of(data: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
42	    values = data.get("nodes") if isinstance(data, dict) else data
43	    if not isinstance(values, list) or not all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in values):
44	        raise ContractError("graph must be an array or an object with nodes[]")
45	    return values
46	
47	
48	def _is_type(value: Any, expected: str) -> bool:
49	    return {
50	        "null": value is None,
51	        "object": isinstance(value, dict),
52	        "array": isinstance(value, list),
53	        "string": isinstance(value, str),
54	        "boolean": isinstance(value, bool),
55	        "integer": isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool),
56	        "number": isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool),
57	    }.get(expected, True)
58	
59	
60	def _format_ok(value: str, expected: str) -> bool:
61	    try:
62	        if expected == "date":
63	            date.fromisoformat(value)
64	        elif expected == "date-time":
65	            datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
66	        elif expected == "uri":
67	            return bool(urlsplit(value).scheme)
68	    except ValueError:
69	        return False
70	    return True
71	
72	
73	def _schema_fallback(value: Any, schema: Any, root: dict[str, Any], path: str = "$") -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
74	    """Deterministic Draft 2020-12 subset used if jsonschema is unavailable."""
75	    if schema is True:
76	        return []
77	    if schema is False or not isinstance(schema, dict):
78	        return [(path, "value is forbidden" if schema is False else "invalid schema object")]
79	    findings: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
80	    reference = schema.get("$ref")
81	    if isinstance(reference, str):
82	        if not reference.startswith("#/"):
83	            return [(path, f"external schema reference is forbidden: {reference}")]
84	        target: Any = root
85	        try:
86	            for part in reference[2:].split("/"):
87	                target = target[part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")]
88	        except (KeyError, TypeError):
89	            return [(path, f"unresolved schema reference: {reference}")]
90	        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, target, root, path))
91	    for child in schema.get("allOf", []):
92	        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, child, root, path))
93	    if "if" in schema and not _schema_fallback(value, schema["if"], root, path) and "then" in schema:
94	        findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value, schema["then"], root, path))
95	    expected = schema.get("type")
96	    if expected is not None:
97	        choices = expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected]
98	        if not any(_is_type(value, choice) for choice in choices):
99	            return findings + [(path, f"expected type {choices}, got {type(value).__name__}")]
100	    if "const" in schema and value != schema["const"]:
101	        findings.append((path, f"expected const {schema['const']!r}"))
102	    if "enum" in schema and value not in schema["enum"]:
103	        findings.append((path, f"not in enum {schema['enum']!r}"))
104	    if isinstance(value, str):
105	        if len(value) < schema.get("minLength", 0):
106	            findings.append((path, "string is shorter than minLength"))
107	        if "pattern" in schema and re.search(schema["pattern"], value) is None:
108	            findings.append((path, f"does not match {schema['pattern']}"))
109	        if "format" in schema and not _format_ok(value, schema["format"]):
110	            findings.append((path, f"invalid {schema['format']} format"))
111	    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
112	        if "minimum" in schema and value < schema["minimum"]:
113	            findings.append((path, "below minimum"))
114	        if "maximum" in schema and value > schema["maximum"]:
115	            findings.append((path, "above maximum"))
116	    if isinstance(value, list):
117	        if len(value) < schema.get("minItems", 0):
118	            findings.append((path, "too few items"))
119	        if "maxItems" in schema and len(value) > schema["maxItems"]:
120	            findings.append((path, "too many items"))
121	        if schema.get("uniqueItems"):
122	            packed = [json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) for item in value]
123	            if len(packed) != len(set(packed)):
124	                findings.append((path, "items are not unique"))
125	        items = schema.get("items")
126	        if isinstance(items, dict):
127	            for index, item in enumerate(value):
128	                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(item, items, root, f"{path}[{index}]"))
129	        if "contains" in schema and not any(not _schema_fallback(item, schema["contains"], root, path) for item in value):
130	            findings.append((path, "contains constraint is not satisfied"))
131	    if isinstance(value, dict):
132	        for key in schema.get("required", []):
133	            if key not in value:
134	                findings.append((path, f"missing required property {key}"))
135	        properties = schema.get("properties", {})
136	        for key, child in properties.items():
137	            if key in value:
138	                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value[key], child, root, f"{path}.{key}"))
139	        additional = schema.get("additionalProperties", True)
140	        unknown = sorted(set(value) - set(properties))
141	        if additional is False and unknown:
142	            findings.append((path, f"unknown properties {unknown}"))
143	        elif isinstance(additional, dict):
144	            for key in unknown:
145	                findings.extend(_schema_fallback(value[key], additional, root, f"{path}.{key}"))
146	    return findings
147	
148	
149	def schema_findings(node: dict[str, Any], schema: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
150	    node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
151	    try:
152	        from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, FormatChecker  # type: ignore
153	    except ImportError:
154	        raw = _schema_fallback(node, schema, schema)
155	    else:
156	        try:
157	            Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
158	        except Exception as exc:
159	            raise ContractError(f"invalid canonical graph schema {SCHEMA_PATH}: {exc}") from exc
160	        validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, format_checker=FormatChecker())
161	        errors = sorted(
162	            validator.iter_errors(node),
163	            key=lambda err: (tuple(str(part) for part in err.absolute_path), err.message),
164	        )
165	        raw = [
166	            ("$" + "".join(f"[{part}]" if isinstance(part, int) else f".{part}" for part in error.absolute_path), error.message)
167	            for error in errors
168	        ]
169	    return [
170	        {"node": node_id, "code": "schema_violation", "detail": f"{path}: {detail}"}
171	        for path, detail in raw
172	    ]
173	
174	
175	def _scalar(raw: str) -> Any:
176	    value = raw.strip()
177	    try:
178	        return json.loads(value)
179	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
180	        if (value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'")) or (value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"')):
181	            return value[1:-1]
182	        return value
183	
184	
185	def frontmatter_of(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
186	    try:
187	        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
188	    except OSError as exc:
189	        raise ContractError(f"cannot read artifact {path}: {exc}") from exc
190	    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != "---":
191	        raise ContractError(f"artifact has no YAML frontmatter: {path}")
192	    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
193	    for line in lines[1:]:
194	        if line.strip() == "---":
195	            return result
196	        match = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*):(?:\s*(.*))?$", line)
197	        if match:
198	            result[match.group(1)] = _scalar(match.group(2) or "")
199	    raise ContractError(f"artifact frontmatter is not terminated: {path}")
200	
201	
202	def _repo_root_for(graph: Path, explicit: str | None) -> Path:
203	    if explicit:
204	        root = Path(explicit).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
205	        contained(graph, root)
206	        return root
207	    resolved = graph.resolve(strict=True)
208	    for parent in resolved.parents:
209	        if parent.name == ".dev-graph":
210	            return parent.parent
211	    raise ContractError("--repo-root is required when --graph is outside the canonical .dev-graph tree")
212	
213	
214	def artifact_findings(
215	    nodes: list[dict[str, Any]], repo_root: Path | None, template_contract: dict[str, Any]
216	) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
217	    findings: list[dict[str, str]] = []
218	    required_frontmatter = set((template_contract.get("common_frontmatter") or {}).get("required") or [])
219	    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
220	        node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
221	        kind = node.get("artifact_kind", node.get("kind"))
222	        raw_path = node.get("file_path")
223	        if kind in ROOT_BY_KIND and isinstance(raw_path, str):
224	            logical = PurePosixPath(raw_path)
225	            if logical.is_absolute() or ".." in logical.parts or not logical.parts or logical.parts[0] != ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]:
226	                findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "path_parity_error", "detail": f"{kind} must be under {ROOT_BY_KIND[kind]}/"})
227	                continue
228	        if repo_root is None or not isinstance(raw_path, str):
229	            continue
230	        candidate = repo_root / raw_path
231	        try:
232	            # Missing canonical artifacts are readiness gaps, not containment
233	            # failures.  Resolve without requiring existence, then let the
234	            # is_file check below classify the missing artifact explicitly.
235	            artifact = contained(candidate, repo_root, must_exist=False)
236	        except (ContractError, OSError) as exc:
237	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "artifact_path_invalid", "detail": str(exc)})
238	            continue
239	        if not artifact.is_file():
240	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "artifact_missing", "detail": raw_path})
241	            continue
242	        try:
243	            frontmatter = frontmatter_of(artifact)
244	        except ContractError as exc:
245	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_invalid", "detail": str(exc)})
246	            continue
247	        for key in sorted(required_frontmatter - set(frontmatter)):
248	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_missing", "detail": key})
249	        for key in ("graph_node_id", "artifact_kind", "file_path", "template_id", "template_version"):
250	            if key in node and frontmatter.get(key) != node.get(key):
251	                findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "frontmatter_parity_error", "detail": key})
252	    return findings
253	
254	
255	def domain_findings(nodes: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
256	    findings: list[dict[str, str]] = []
257	    ids: list[str] = []
258	    by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
259	    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
260	        node_id = node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id")
261	        loc = str(node_id or f"nodes[{index}]")
262	        if not isinstance(node_id, str) or not node_id:
263	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "missing_id", "detail": "graph_node_id required"})
264	            continue
265	        ids.append(node_id)
266	        by_id[node_id] = node
267	        kind = node.get("artifact_kind", node.get("kind"))
268	        if kind is not None and kind not in ROOT_BY_KIND:
269	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_kind", "detail": str(kind)})
270	        if node.get("status") not in {"draft", "active", "blocked", "done", "closed", "tombstoned"}:
271	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_status", "detail": str(node.get("status"))})
272	        dependencies = node.get("depends_on", [])
273	        if not isinstance(dependencies, list) or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in dependencies):
274	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "invalid_dependencies", "detail": "depends_on must be string[]"})
275	        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "beads" and (node.get("github_publication") or {}).get("mode") != "local_only":
276	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "beads_publication", "detail": "beads requires local_only"})
277	        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "github" and node.get("beads_linkage") is not None:
278	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "binding_collision", "detail": "github cannot have beads_linkage"})
279	        if node.get("status") == "active":
280	            readiness = (node.get("implementation_readiness") or {}).get("status")
281	            if node.get("confirmation_status") != "confirmed" or node.get("evaluation_status") != "pass" or readiness != "complete":
282	                findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "active_not_ready", "detail": "active requires confirmed/pass/complete"})
283	        if node.get("tracker_binding") == "repo-config-default":
284	            findings.append({"node": loc, "code": "unresolved_tracker_binding", "detail": "durable graph cannot retain repo-config-default"})
285	    for duplicate, count in Counter(ids).items():
286	        if count > 1:
287	            findings.append({"node": duplicate, "code": "duplicate_id", "detail": str(count)})
288	    reference_fields = ("depends_on", "related_nodes", "architecture_refs")
289	    for index, node in enumerate(nodes):
290	        node_id = str(node.get("graph_node_id") or node.get("id") or f"nodes[{index}]")
291	        for field in reference_fields:
292	            for reference in node.get(field, []) if isinstance(node.get(field, []), list) else []:
293	                if reference not in by_id:
294	                    code = "dangling_dependency" if field == "depends_on" else "dangling_reference"
295	                    findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": code, "detail": f"{field}:{reference}"})
296	        parent = node.get("parent_feature")
297	        if isinstance(parent, str) and parent not in by_id:
298	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "dangling_reference", "detail": f"parent_feature:{parent}"})
299	
300	    state: dict[str, int] = {}
301	
302	    def visit(node_id: str) -> None:
303	        if state.get(node_id) == 1:
304	            findings.append({"node": node_id, "code": "dependency_cycle", "detail": node_id})
305	            return
306	        if state.get(node_id) == 2:

109	
110	グラフの依存関係・完了状態・active worktree leaseから次に着手すべきready-setと、リソーススコープ/lease重複のない複数worktree向け並列バッチを算出・提示した状態になっている

113	
114	依存関係を都度人手で追跡せずに次の一手を判断できるようにする。binding=beadsはC28でstatusとdepends_on edge exact-set parityがconfirmedの場合だけbd ready候補を採用し、parity pending/conflictは推薦しない。その候補へdev-graph固有のresource_scope/lease重複回避を重ねる。github/noneはC16で自前算出し、mode=bothはbinding別結果を合成する。二層ready-set: feature ready (機能間depends_on充足) はper-feature planning起動候補、task ready (feature内depends_on充足+resource_scope非競合) は実行候補として区別し、feature単位の並列batchとtask単位の並列batchを混在させない (MM-10)

153	```

157	- `criteria:IN1`: `schedule-graph.py` の ready-set に blocked/draft/unconfirmed/evaluation非pass/readiness非complete の候補が 0件であることを script test で検証する。

### ゴール (Goal)

グラフの依存関係・完了状態・active worktree leaseから次に着手すべきready-setと、リソーススコープ/lease重複のない複数worktree向け並列バッチを算出・提示した状態になっている

### 目的・背景 (Why)

依存関係を都度人手で追跡せずに次の一手を判断できるようにする。binding=beadsはC28でstatusとdepends_on edge exact-set parityがconfirmedの場合だけbd ready候補を採用し、parity pending/conflictは推薦しない。その候補へdev-graph固有のresource_scope/lease重複回避を重ねる。github/noneはC16で自前算出し、mode=bothはbinding別結果を合成する。二層ready-set: feature ready (機能間depends_on充足) はper-feature planning起動候補、task ready (feature内depends_on充足+resource_scope非競合) は実行候補として区別し、feature単位の並列batchとtask単位の並列batchを混在させない (MM-10)

### 完了チェックリスト

- [ ] candidate は confirmed/pass/readiness complete、全 depends_on done、active lease なしを満たす
- [ ] feature ready と task ready が別々の ready-set/batch に出力される
- [ ] 同一 parallel batch の resource_scope.touches 重複 pair が0件である
- [ ] 各 task の suggested_branch が `devgraph/<graph_node_id>` で claim command が public CLI 形式である
- [ ] 実行前後の graph/tracker/lease digest が同一である

### ゴールシークループ

frontmatter の `goal_seek.engine: inline` / `fork: subagent` / `max_loops: 5` を実行契約とする。固定手順は使わず、未達 checklist と担当 `prompts/*.md` からその周回の操作を都度生成する。各周回で inner criterion を検証し、完了後は outer criterion の live trial/content review を最大 `feedback_contract.max_iterations=3` 周で評価する。

### ゴールシーク配線

- 開始時に C24 `resolve-repo-context.py --mode read` の JSON receipt を得て、`repo_root` が `content_roots.repository` の realpath と一致する場合だけ `DEV_GRAPH_ROOT=<receipt.repo_root>` に固定する。cwd から再解決しない。
- 元のゴールを `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-schedule-goal-spec.json` へ、各 checklist の status/evidence を `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-schedule-progress.json` へ記録する。
- 未達 responsibility を担当する `prompts/<R-id>.md` を読み、`Agent` で分離 context に fork する。ユーザー判断が必要な境界だけ `AskUserQuestion` を使う。
- 各周回末に `$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-schedule-intermediate.jsonl` へ `original_goal`、`original_goal_hash`、`current_goal_snapshot`、`delta_from_original`、`merged_directive_for_next`、`drift_signal` を append-only で記録する。次周回は直前の `merged_directive_for_next` を必須入力にする。
- 5周到達時に未達が残れば完了扱いせず、progress と blocker を親へ handoff する。全 checklist と `feedback_contract.criteria` が PASS のときだけ完了する。

### ゴールシーク検証

各周回後に次の検査を実行し、中間成果物の欠落・goal drift・hash 不一致を fail-closed にする。

```bash
python3 - "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-schedule-goal-spec.json" "$DEV_GRAPH_ROOT/eval-log/run-dev-graph-schedule-intermediate.jsonl" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
goal = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8'))
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]

assert rows, 'intermediate.jsonl is empty'
for row in rows:
    assert required_keys <= row.keys(), required_keys - row.keys()
    assert row['original_goal'] == goal['original_goal']
    assert row['original_goal_hash'] == expected
PY
```

## Criteria acceptance

- `criteria:IN1`: `schedule-graph.py` の ready-set に blocked/draft/unconfirmed/evaluation非pass/readiness非complete の候補が 0件であることを script test で検証する。
- `criteria:OUT1`: 推薦 task は全 `depends_on` がdoneで、未充足依存を持つ候補が ready-set に0件であることを受入テストで検証する。
- `criteria:OUT2`: 同一parallel batch内の `resource_scope.touches` 重複ペアが0件で、active leaseと衝突する候補を推薦しないことを受入テストで検証する。

- `blocked/draft/unconfirmed/evaluation!=pass/readiness!=complete` のどれかを ready に混入させない。
- 直接依存だけでなく全 `depends_on` の done を確認する。

# 目的

予約枠と担当者割当を保持する基盤テーブルが作成され、後続の API/UI/worker 実装がひとつのデータ定義を参照できる状態になっている。

## 背景

スケジューリング機能の全実装は同一の予約枠テーブルを前提にする。データ定義が確定しないまま API と UI を並行実装すると型不一致が後段で顕在化するため、最初に基盤スキーマだけを単独タスクとして完了させる。

## 入力と前提条件

- 入力: 予約ドメインの用語定義と保持期間ポリシー
- 前提: マイグレーション実行環境が利用可能であること

## 出力と成果物

- 生成物: src/db 配下の予約枠・担当者割当テーブル定義とマイグレーション
- 更新対象: src/db のスキーマ定義一式

## 依存関係

- `depends_on`: なし (基盤タスクのため先行依存を持たない)
- ブロッカー: なし

## 実装対象

- Frontend: N/A: このタスクは永続層のみを対象とする
- Backend/API: N/A: 後続タスクで実装する
- Database/Data: 予約枠テーブルと担当者割当テーブルおよび索引を追加する
- Infrastructure: N/A: 既存のデータベース構成を変更しない
- Security/Privacy: N/A: 個人識別情報を新規に保持しない
- Documentation: スキーマ定義のコメントを更新する

## Write scope と競合制約

- `touches`: src/db
- 排他資源: src/db
- 並列実行条件: src/db を触る他タスクと同一 batch に入れない
- branch: devgraph/gm-schedule-t01-base-schema
- worktree lease: 実装前に graph_node_id を claim し 60 秒間隔で heartbeat、完了時に release する
- completion projection: feature branch は pending event のみ記録し、default branch の reconciliation が done を書く

- Mode: local_only

- Issue labels/milestone: N/A: local_only のため付与しない
- Initial Project fields: N/A: local_only のため投影しない

- Local reconciliation: manual sync

## 実行手順

1. 予約枠と担当者割当の列定義および制約を確定する。
2. マイグレーションを追加し、ロールバック手順を併記する。
3. マイグレーションを適用し、索引が期待どおり作成されたことを確認する。

## 受入条件

- [ ] 予約枠テーブルと担当者割当テーブルが作成され、外部キー制約が有効である
- [ ] マイグレーションが適用と巻き戻しの双方で成功する

114	def _compact(value: Any) -> str:
115	    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
116	
117	
118	def _ordered_output(value: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
119	    """Preserve human-review field order; receipt canonicalization remains sorted."""
120	    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))

123	def _sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
124	    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()

127	def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
128	    return _sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes())

131	def _command(value: str) -> list[str]:
132	    try:
133	        parsed = json.loads(value)
134	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
135	        raise GuardError(f"command-json is invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc
136	    if (
137	        not isinstance(parsed, list)
138	        or not parsed
139	        or not all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in parsed)
140	    ):
141	        raise GuardError("command-json must be a non-empty JSON string array")
142	    return parsed

145	def _command_sha256(argv: list[str]) -> str:
146	    return _sha256_bytes(_compact(argv).encode("utf-8"))

149	def _action_class(argv: list[str]) -> str | None:
150	    """Classify argv into an auto-grantable class; unknown or irreversible argv stays None."""
151	    program = Path(argv[0]).name
152	    rest = argv[1:]
153	    if program == "gh" and len(rest) >= 2:
154	        surface, verb = rest[0], rest[1]
155	        if surface == "pr" and verb in GH_PR_AUTO_VERBS:
156	            return "github-pr-write"
157	        if surface == "issue" and verb in GH_ISSUE_AUTO_VERBS:
158	            return "github-issue-write"
159	        return None
160	    if program == "bd" and rest:
161	        if rest[0] in BD_AUTO_VERBS:
162	            return "beads-issue-write"
163	        if rest[0] == "dep" and len(rest) >= 2 and rest[1] == "add":
164	            return "beads-issue-write"
165	    return None

168	def _intent_classes(prompt: str) -> frozenset[str]:
169	    granted: set[str] = set()
170	    for pattern, classes in INTENT_PATTERNS:
171	        if pattern.search(prompt):
172	            granted |= set(classes)
173	    return frozenset(granted & AUTO_GRANT_CLASSES)

176	def _review_text(value: str, *, name: str) -> str:
177	    normalized = " ".join(value.split())
178	    if not normalized:
179	        raise GuardError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
180	    if len(normalized.encode("utf-8")) > 2048:
181	        raise GuardError(f"{name} exceeds 2048 UTF-8 bytes")
182	    return normalized

185	def _project_root(value: str) -> Path:
186	    try:
187	        root = Path(value).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
188	    except OSError as exc:
189	        raise GuardError(f"project root does not exist: {value}") from exc
190	    if not root.is_dir():
191	        raise GuardError(f"project root is not a directory: {root}")
192	    return root

195	def _state_dir(root: Path, *, create: bool) -> Path:
196	    state = root / STATE_REL
197	    if create:
198	        state.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
199	        os.chmod(state, 0o700)
200	    try:
201	        resolved = state.resolve(strict=True)
202	    except OSError as exc:
203	        raise GuardError(f"guard state is unavailable: {state}") from exc
204	    try:
205	        resolved.relative_to(root)
206	    except ValueError as exc:
207	        raise GuardError("guard state escapes project root") from exc
208	    return resolved

211	def _key(state: Path, *, create: bool) -> bytes:
212	    path = state / KEY_NAME
213	    if create and not path.exists():
214	        try:
215	            descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
216	        except FileExistsError:
217	            pass
218	        else:
219	            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
220	                handle.write(secrets.token_bytes(32))
221	    try:
222	        value = path.read_bytes()
223	    except OSError as exc:
224	        raise GuardError("guard key is unavailable") from exc
225	    if len(value) != 32:
226	        raise GuardError("guard key is invalid")
227	    return value

230	def _seal(body: dict[str, Any], key: bytes) -> str:
231	    unsigned = {name: value for name, value in body.items() if name != "seal"}
232	    return hmac.new(key, _compact(unsigned).encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
233

235	def _write_receipt(state: Path, name: str, body: dict[str, Any], key: bytes) -> Path:
236	    destination = state / name
237	    if destination.exists():
238	        raise GuardError(f"receipt already exists: {destination.name}")
239	    document = {**body, "seal": _seal(body, key)}
240	    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{name}.", dir=state)
241	    try:
242	        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
243	            json.dump(document, handle, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
244	            handle.write("\n")
245	            handle.flush()
246	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
247	        os.chmod(temporary, 0o600)
248	        os.replace(temporary, destination)
249	    finally:
250	        if os.path.exists(temporary):
251	            os.unlink(temporary)
252	    return destination
253	
254	
255	def _write_once(state: Path, name: str, body: dict[str, Any], key: bytes) -> Path:
256	    """Atomically create a sealed claim; an existing claim is never replaced."""
257	    destination = state / name
258	    document = {**body, "seal": _seal(body, key)}
259	    try:
260	        descriptor = os.open(destination, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
261	    except FileExistsError as exc:
262	        raise GuardError("preview and confirmation were already consumed by authorization") from exc
263	    try:
264	        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
265	            json.dump(document, handle, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
266	            handle.write("\n")
267	            handle.flush()
268	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
269	    except BaseException:
270	        # A partially written O_EXCL claim remains fail-closed and cannot be replayed.
271	        raise
272	    return destination
273

275	def _receipt(state: Path, raw_path: str, expected_kind: str, key: bytes) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]:
276	    try:
277	        path = Path(raw_path).expanduser().resolve(strict=True)
278	        path.relative_to(state)
279	    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
280	        raise GuardError("receipt path is outside canonical guard state") from exc
281	    try:
282	        document = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
283	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
284	        raise GuardError(f"receipt is unreadable: {path}") from exc
285	    if not isinstance(document, dict):
286	        raise GuardError("receipt root must be an object")
287	    if document.get("contract_id") != CONTRACT_ID or document.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
288	        raise GuardError("receipt contract identity drift")
289	    if document.get("kind") != expected_kind:
290	        raise GuardError(f"expected {expected_kind} receipt")
291	    seal = document.get("seal")
292	    if not isinstance(seal, str) or not hmac.compare_digest(seal, _seal(document, key)):
293	        raise GuardError("receipt seal mismatch; receipt may be tampered")
294	    expires_at = document.get("expires_at")
295	    if not isinstance(expires_at, int) or expires_at < int(time.time()):
296	        raise GuardError("receipt expired")
297	    return path, document
298

300	def _base(kind: str, receipt_id: str, *, now: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
301	    return {
302	        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
303	        "contract_id": CONTRACT_ID,
304	        "kind": kind,
305	        "receipt_id": receipt_id,
306	        "issued_at": now,
307	        # Second resolution cannot order two receipts issued inside the same second.
308	        "issued_at_ns": time.time_ns(),
309	        "expires_at": now + TTL_SECONDS,
310	    }

313	def _issued_ns(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
314	    value = receipt.get("issued_at_ns")
315	    if isinstance(value, int):
316	        return value
317	    return int(receipt["issued_at"]) * 1_000_000_000

320	def preview(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
321	    root = _project_root(args.project_root)
322	    state = _state_dir(root, create=True)
323	    key = _key(state, create=True)
324	    argv = _command(args.command_json)
325	    if not ENTRYPOINT_RE.fullmatch(args.entrypoint_ref):
326	        raise GuardError("entrypoint-ref must be a canonical plugin SKILL.md ref")
327	    target_scope = _review_text(args.target_scope, name="target-scope")
328	    diff_summary = _review_text(args.diff_summary, name="diff-summary")
329	    side_effect_summary = _review_text(args.side_effect_summary, name="side-effect-summary")
330	    now = int(time.time())
331	    receipt_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
332	    challenge = secrets.token_hex(12).upper()
333	    action_class = _action_class(argv)
334	    body = {
335	        **_base("preview", receipt_id, now=now),
336	        "entrypoint_ref": args.entrypoint_ref,
337	        "target_scope": target_scope,
338	        "command_argv": argv,
339	        "command_sha256": _command_sha256(argv),
340	        "action_class": action_class,
341	        "diff_summary": diff_summary,
342	        "side_effect_summary": side_effect_summary,
343	        "challenge_sha256": _sha256_bytes(challenge.encode("ascii")),
344	        "status": "pending-user-confirmation",
345	    }
346	    path = _write_receipt(state, f"preview-{receipt_id}.json", body, key)
347	    auto_grantable = action_class in AUTO_GRANT_CLASSES
348	    instruction = f"Reply exactly: CONFIRM EXTERNAL MUTATION {challenge}"
349	    if auto_grantable:
350	        instruction = (
351	            f"A live intent grant covering {action_class} authorizes this via authorize-intent; "
352	            f"otherwise reply exactly: CONFIRM EXTERNAL MUTATION {challenge}"
353	        )
354	    return {
355	        "contract_id": CONTRACT_ID,
356	        "status": "preview-created",
357	        "receipt_path": str(path),
358	        "receipt_sha256": _sha256_file(path),
359	        "target_scope": target_scope,
360	        "command_argv": argv,
361	        "action_class": action_class,
362	        "auto_grantable": auto_grantable,
363	        "diff_summary": diff_summary,
364	        "side_effect_summary": side_effect_summary,
365	        "challenge": challenge,
366	        "user_instruction": instruction,
367	    }

371	    try:
372	        value = json.loads(sys.stdin.read() or "{}")

378	def hook_confirm() -> dict[str, Any] | None:
379	    payload = _read_hook_payload()
380	    if payload.get("hook_event_name") not in {None, "UserPromptSubmit"}:
381	        return None
382	    prompt = payload.get("prompt")
383	    cwd = payload.get("cwd")
384	    session_id = payload.get("session_id")
385	    if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not isinstance(cwd, str) or not isinstance(session_id, str):
386	        return None
387	    stripped = prompt.strip()
388	    root = _project_root(cwd)
389	    matched = CONFIRM_RE.fullmatch(stripped)
390	    if matched is not None:
391	        return _confirm_challenge(root, stripped, session_id, matched.group(1))
392	    granted = _intent_classes(stripped)
393	    if not granted:
394	        return None
395	    return _grant_intent(root, stripped, session_id, granted)

398	def _user_event_id(session_id: str, prompt: str) -> str:
399	    return _sha256_bytes(f"{session_id}\0{prompt}".encode("utf-8"))

402	def _confirm_challenge(
403	    root: Path, prompt: str, session_id: str, challenge: str
404	) -> dict[str, Any]:
405	    """Bind a typed challenge to its single live preview.
406	
407	    A challenge that matches no live preview creates no receipt and does not block the
408	    prompt: refusing the user's message buys no safety and strands the session.
409	    """
410	    unmatched = {
411	        "contract_id": CONTRACT_ID,
412	        "status": "confirmation-unmatched",
413	        "detail": "no live preview matches this challenge; it may have expired or been consumed",
414	    }
415	    try:
416	        state = _state_dir(root, create=False)
417	        key = _key(state, create=False)
418	    except GuardError:
419	        return unmatched
420	    challenge_hash = _sha256_bytes(challenge.encode("ascii"))
421	    candidates: list[tuple[Path, dict[str, Any]]] = []
422	    for path in sorted(state.glob("preview-*.json")):
423	        try:
424	            loaded_path, receipt = _receipt(state, str(path), "preview", key)
425	        except GuardError:
426	            continue
427	        if receipt.get("challenge_sha256") == challenge_hash:
428	            candidates.append((loaded_path, receipt))
429	    if len(candidates) != 1:
430	        return unmatched
431	    preview_path, preview_receipt = candidates[0]
432	    now = int(time.time())
433	    receipt_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
434	    body = {
435	        **_base("confirmation", receipt_id, now=now),
436	        "preview_receipt_id": preview_receipt["receipt_id"],
437	        "preview_receipt_sha256": _sha256_file(preview_path),
438	        "producer": "claude-code-user-prompt-submit",
439	        "user_event_id": _user_event_id(session_id, prompt),
440	        "decision": "confirm",
441	    }
442	    path = _write_receipt(state, f"confirmation-{receipt_id}.json", body, key)
443	    return {
444	        "contract_id": CONTRACT_ID,
445	        "status": "confirmation-created",
446	        "receipt_path": str(path),
447	        "receipt_sha256": _sha256_file(path),
448	    }

451	def _grant_intent(
452	    root: Path, prompt: str, session_id: str, granted: frozenset[str]
453	) -> dict[str, Any]:
454	    """Seal a single-use grant proving a human asked for this class of mutation."""
455	    state = _state_dir(root, create=True)
456	    key = _key(state, create=True)
457	    now = int(time.time())
458	    receipt_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
459	    body = {
460	        **_base(INTENT_KIND, receipt_id, now=now),
461	        "granted_classes": sorted(granted),
462	        "producer": "claude-code-user-prompt-submit",
463	        "user_event_id": _user_event_id(session_id, prompt),
464	        "prompt_excerpt": " ".join(prompt.split())[:200],
465	        "decision": "confirm-by-intent",
466	    }
467	    path = _write_receipt(state, f"{INTENT_KIND}-{receipt_id}.json", body, key)
468	    return {
469	        "contract_id": CONTRACT_ID,
470	        "status": "intent-granted",
471	        "receipt_path": str(path),
472	        "receipt_sha256": _sha256_file(path),
473	        "granted_classes": sorted(granted),
474	    }

477	def authorize(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
478	    root = _project_root(args.project_root)
479	    state = _state_dir(root, create=False)
480	    key = _key(state, create=False)
481	    preview_path, preview_receipt = _receipt(state, args.preview_receipt, "preview", key)
482	    confirmation_path, confirmation_receipt = _receipt(
483	        state, args.confirmation_receipt, "confirmation", key
484	    )
485	    if (
486	        confirmation_receipt.get("preview_receipt_id") != preview_receipt["receipt_id"]
487	        or confirmation_receipt.get("preview_receipt_sha256") != _sha256_file(preview_path)
488	    ):
489	        raise GuardError("confirmation receipt is not bound to the supplied preview receipt")
490	    return _seal_authorization(
491	        state,
492	        key,
493	        preview_path,
494	        preview_receipt,
495	        confirmation_path,
496	        confirmation_receipt,
497	        confirmation_kind="confirmation",
498	    )

501	def authorize_intent(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
502	    """Authorize an auto-grantable preview against a live human intent grant."""
503	    root = _project_root(args.project_root)
504	    state = _state_dir(root, create=False)
505	    key = _key(state, create=False)
506	    preview_path, preview_receipt = _receipt(state, args.preview_receipt, "preview", key)
507	    intent_path, intent_receipt = _receipt(state, args.intent_receipt, INTENT_KIND, key)
508	    action_class = preview_receipt.get("action_class")
509	    if action_class not in AUTO_GRANT_CLASSES:
510	        raise GuardError(
511	            "preview action class is not auto-grantable; use the typed confirmation flow"
512	        )
513	    granted = intent_receipt.get("granted_classes")
